verdict.rationale: The portals offer public search of register entries and Registerbekanntmachungen (register announcements) across all federal states. A founder can therefore confirm once a filing has been entered or published. Nothing shows a public way to track a pending filing or application while it is in progress, and the portal itself notes overload-driven unavailability. Missing for 10: status tracking for pending or in-process filings, case/reference-number lookup, any documented status-visibility feature, independent or hands-on corroboration.
